text:
elaine: Heads up — planning a canary retest for the pen-test findings that hit the model-serving path. Need ephemeral KMS grants, minimal RBAC carve-outs, and a signed audit export for evidence. Target window: Wed 2025-06-11 14:00 PT. Who can own orchestration and evidence packaging?

sam: I can own the RBAC changes. Quick Q: do we want short-lived service-account creds or assume-role style ephemeral roles?

mike: assume-role via our KMS-proxy is best. Less IAM churn. Two-hour window should be enough if we pre-stage snapshots/logs.

ops-oncall: Confirmed available Wed 14:00 PT. Will pre-stage S3 prefix and a read-only snapshot. Need exact list of log exports we must capture.

elaine: Vulnerability list for this run: VULN-2025-0421, VULN-2025-0423, VULN-2025-0450. Evidence chain requests: (1) signed audit-export from auth-proxy with sig + timestamp, (2) KV-cache manifests, (3) model-serving node snapshots. We need SHA256 for each artifact.

security-bot: Checklist: 1) Ephemeral roles created with ttl=2h 2) Audit export job scheduled 3) S3 prefix pre-created with bucket-policies 4) Evidence hash recorded. See runbook link: https://intranet.redwood/retest-runbook

sam: RBAC scope proposal (minimal):
- grant: role:pen-test-runner (assume only during window)
- permissions: logs:Read, kms:Encrypt/Decrypt via proxy, s3:PutObject (evidence-only)
- deny: admin:*
Will push IAM change as a canary commit and gate with review.

mike: For KMS: we'll issue a temporary key-wrapping grant that proxies to customer-keystore. Pattern: assume-role -> proxy -> KMS Unwrap. Ops to create grant id: grant-canary-1744448000.

ops-oncall: I'll create S3 prefix: s3://redwood-evidence/canary/1744448000/ and pre-create a manifest file placeholder. Also will snapshot the serving nodes using the usual snapshotter: 
```
/opt/snapshotter/bin/snap --target model-serving --out /tmp/ms-snap-1744448000.tar.gz
sha256sum /tmp/ms-snap-1744448000.tar.gz > /tmp/ms-snap-1744448000.sha256
aws s3 cp /tmp/ms-snap-1744448000.tar.gz s3://redwood-evidence/canary/1744448000/
aws s3 cp /tmp/ms-snap-1744448000.sha256 s3://redwood-evidence/canary/1744448000/
```
Will run these pre-window and mark files as immutable for 24h.

elaine: We also need signed audit export from auth-proxy. Sam, can you add an export job that calls: 
```
POST /admin/audit/export 
{ "since": "-2h", "dest": "s3://redwood-evidence/canary/1744448000/audit.json.gz" }
```
Auth-proxy should sign the payload and place a signature file audit.json.gz.sig next to the export.

sam: Yup. I'll add the export job and ensure the auth-proxy produces an HMAC signature using the ephemeral role key. Will store signature at audit.json.gz.sig.

mike: One more ask — fallback routing during the run. If latency or error rate crosses threshold, route traffic to the read-only replica model variant and log a fallback event. Ops-Alert should capture those fallback events. We should include fallback flag in the evidence manifest.

ops-oncall: Can implement a simple health-check rule: if 5xx rate > 1% for 2 consecutive minutes, flip route. I'll hook it to the evidence manifest and add a fallback.log entry.

elaine: Acceptance criteria for retest pass: all three vuln IDs reproduce evidence of fix (no exploit path), audit export present and signed, artifacts uploaded with matching SHA256, and a post-run verification checklist filled (by security). If any item missing -> fail and schedule follow-up retest.

sam: After run, I'll rotate the ephemeral role binding and revoke any granted policies. Also will attach a playbook for rollback if we see elevated errors.

security-bot: Reminder: create JIRA ticket RETEST-211 and attach s3 prefix. Auto-tag testers and ops.

mike: I'll own the canary infra and watch the metrics dashboard. Planning to stream logs to the retention bucket for 48h.

ops-oncall: All set on my side. I'll post a DM with pre-signed URLs once uploads are complete.

elaine: Excellent. Owner list: orchestration=elaine, RBAC=sam, infra=mike, ops=ops-oncall, security-review=security. Please react when confirmed.

sam: @elaine confirmed.

mike: :thumbsup: I'll set the health rule and grant id.

ops-oncall: :white_check_mark: pre-staging done (will re-verify 30m before window).

elaine: Thanks — I'll circulate the run checklist and link RETEST-211 once created.

security-bot: Scheduled run created for 1744448000. Notifications will be sent 1h and 15m before window.
